SELECT TO_CHAR(date_trunc(, send_repair_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period, AS metricValue, COUNT(*) AS repairCount, SUM(CASE WHEN repair_judgment_result = '报废' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scrapQty FROM qms.production_repair WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND send_repair_date >= #{start}::date AND send_repair_date <= #{end}::date
GROUP BY date_trunc(, send_repair_date) ORDER BY period

SELECT AS name, AS metricValue, COUNT(*) AS repairCount, SUM(CASE WHEN repair_judgment_result = '报废' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scrapQty, ROUND( * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM() OVER (), 0), 2) AS sharePct FROM qms.production_repair WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND send_repair_date >= #{start}::date AND send_repair_date <= #{end}::date
AND IS NOT NULL AND != '' GROUP BY ORDER BY metricValue DESC LIMIT #{topN}
